name: The Billionaire's Proposal
source:
Sunday is a day reserved for love. But what if everything goes its own way and one unexpected call changes your entire life? You get a very mysterious offer that can turn your life upside down and make all your dreams come true.

[From in-app]
translation:
星期天是留给爱情的日子。可如果一切都偏离了计划，一通意料之外的电话改变了你的整个人生呢？你收到了一份神秘的邀约，它可能彻底颠覆你的生活，让你所有的梦想成真。

[摘自应用内介绍]
